get_all_files: recursively find all files in a directory tree matching a given extension and optional path substring
moving_average: compute a moving average of a numeric data list over a specified period using numpy convolution
tensor_slice: slice a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors along a specified dimension between start and end indices
one_hot: convert a column vector of integer indices into a one-hot encoded PyTorch tensor with n classes
set_all_seeds: set random seeds for Python random, NumPy, and PyTorch CPU and CUDA for reproducible experiments
